title: Website Improvement Finding
description: Schema for every finding produced by the S1-S10 auditors. One shape for every agent, so merge-findings.mjs, rank-findings.mjs and the orchestrator never have to special-case a source.

id.description: Unique finding id. The two characters are the agent, e.g. F-S8-0001.

agent.description: The auditor that produced this finding.

severity.description: P0 blocking (1000), P1 critical (300), P2 major (100), P3 minor (30). Drives the priority weight.

title.description: Short imperative title. Normalized titles are part of the dedupe key, so reword the same defect consistently across agents.

evidence.description: At least one item. A finding with no file:line or no command output is a guess, not a finding.

file.description: Path relative to the project root. The first entry becomes part of the dedupe key.

line.description: 1-indexed line number. Use 1 with a file-level measurement such as a whole-file count.

snippet.description: The offending code, trimmed. Never paste a secret or a whole file.

measurement.description: The quantified observation: '14 call sites', 'axe: color-contrast, 6 nodes', '412 kB gzip'.

impact.description: User or business impact. 1 cosmetic, 5 data loss, security hole or an unusable main flow.

fix_sketch.description: The approach in a sentence or two. Not the diff.

metric.description: The single number this fix must move. One metric per finding keeps before/after honest.

name.description: Metric key, e.g. bundle_kb, axe_critical, runtime_errors.

before.description: The measured value now. A number you actually observed, never an estimate.

after_null_ok.description: The value after the fix, or null until it is applied. Null means unmeasured, not zero.

files_touched.description: Files the fix would change. The first is the dedupe key; list the primary file first.

status.description: blocked_backend means the fix needs a server, database or schema change and is out of scope for a frontend loop.

reported_by.description: Set by merge-findings.mjs when several agents reported the same defect. Do not write this yourself.
